scope: CPU qualification of reservations on irregular fork/join DAGs; no learned-model claim
objective: Sum of job completion times from terminal sinks; raw summed task RTT is a distinct secondary metric
information: All DAGs, eligibility, durations, setup transitions, locks and power domains announced at time zero to every arm
hand_starts: Fastest and affinity placements crossed with short-job, short-operation, critical-path, downstream-work, lock-pressure and 1/2/4-hop graph priorities; both decoders where allowed; all work charged
selection: Largest scale rung meeting proxy p95 and capacity bars. Lowest mean median-repeat objective among arms meeting every calibration timing repeat; freeze before fresh inputs. Never drop overruns.
reference_claim: Best retained feasible plan from diverse full-budget controls and eighteen longer trajectories; no optimality or general no-headroom certificate
live_gate: Six small parity runs including the certified reservation witness and concurrent diamond, eight scale runs, four calibration-selected runs and 48 fresh baseline/control/reference runs. Scale failure still completes its registered fourteen parity/scale runs.
future_gates: A headroom pass requires fresh hand-reservation/lookahead challenge and residual graph information beyond trained 1/2/4-hop hand controls before matched GNN/MP-OFF training. No GPU from this screen alone.
interpretation: A failed finite reference stops advancement of this recipe only. The four-operation prior witness proves old action incompleteness, not a GNN advantage on this generator.
